entries.title: Semi-Permeable Membrane with Water Flow and Solute Particles
entries.description: A transparent rectangular membrane panel divides two boxes of particles, where blue water spheres drift through membrane pores while larger colored solute spheres bounce, gradually changing solute concentration gradients shown by labels and dynamic color shading on each side.

entries.title: Red Blood Cell in Hypo/Hypertonic Solutions
entries.description: A single red, flexible cell (a slightly squishy sphere) floats in a clear box filled with tiny blue water particles, swelling and shrinking as water particles pass through its semi-transparent membrane, with arrows and labels indicating hypotonic and hypertonic states.

   A long transparent cylinder shows water with mixed solute particles flowing through membrane layers, where high-pressure plunger spheres push water molecules through a fine membrane sheet while colored pollutant spheres are blocked and accumulate upstream.

5. **Osmosis Across Multiple Serial Membranes**
   A chain of several vertical semi-transparent membranes separates many small compartments, with variable solute concentrations; water particles slowly migrate through pores from low to high solute compartments, equalizing levels while color gradients and numeric labels update.
